Locally verified on Windows with Python 3.14.7, FastMCP 2.14.7 and the packaged OpenMausBot server 0.1.118. The original suite passed 11 tests, including live stdio checks. The repository includes reproducible tests; other versions are not certified.

This independent project is not an official OpenMausBot or OpenAI product. No API keys, app runtime, or tunnel binaries are included.
